how: the failure note's argument, by hand: for sections with Psi(D_h x) = R_h Psi(x), a lift acting as U Psi(x) = B Psi(F^-1 x) with F = D_h and B = R_h gives U Psi(x) = R_h Psi(D_h^-1 x) = R_h R_h^-1 Psi(x) = Psi(x). So a coefficient character alone does not survive; the argument factor can cancel it
